stem.en: In a very long chat, a model says something that goes against a decision made at the start. Which explanation fits best?

text.en: The early text is past the edge of the context window
The chat nudged its settings, so it changed its view
It forgot slowly, as people forget over many weeks
Its temperature rose as the chat became much longer

explanation.en: The model scores tokens from the text inside its context window, so text past the edge plays no part. Using a model changes no setting, it does not fade like a person's memory, and temperature is a run option that a long chat does not change.
